"Lovers in Playa Rosa" is a romantic comedy visual novel and yuri dating sim that follows the journey of our protagonist, Tina Lee, a hard-working barkeeper who travels to Mexico to seek better opportunities and explore the joys of lesbian love.With its engaging storyline, charming characters, and beautiful artwork,
